description:
Overview

Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world. We are a team of passionate individuals about hardware, software, and network infrastructure looking to build the fastest, easiest-to-use, developer-centric single-tenant Cloud infrastructure. If you share this passion, join our growing team of talented people and help build the future of the Internet.

Summary

As a Technical Product Marketing Specialist at Latitude.sh, you’ll bridge the gap between product, engineering, and marketing to accelerate the adoption of our global bare-metal platform. You’ll craft narratives and technical stories that resonate with infrastructure decision-makers — from developers and platform engineers to heads of cloud — translating complex infrastructure capabilities into clear, differentiated business value.

This role plays a key part in how we position and launch new technical capabilities, educate the market on why bare metal makes modern workloads succeed, and help customers understand how to build faster, more efficient platforms on top of Latitude.sh.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop technical narratives and enablement content (from guides and whitepapers to supporting the development of solution briefs, blog posts, and product pages) that articulate the value of our bare-metal solutions and accelerate user adoption.
  • Increase product awareness within the DevOps community and drive product adoption by expanding the user base and activating existing users.
  • Scale production of technical assets that showcase how our platform solves real-world problems in cloud infrastructure and across different verticals like Web3, AI/ML, SaaS, and edge computing.
  • Track and analyze product-marketing performance metrics to provide actionable insights that refine messaging, guide product strategy, and inform go-to-market priorities.
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and networking teams to translate complex infrastructure features into clear customer-facing benefits across different content formats.
  • Develop and refine our technical personas, conduct surveys, and synthesize customer insights to inform product direction, feature prioritization, and messaging strategies.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure consistent storytelling, technical accuracy, and seamless execution of product marketing initiatives across campaigns, product releases, and customer touchpoints.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product marketing experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps platforms, or B2B technology (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, or similar technical products).
  • Strong project management skills with experience driving cross-functional launches and initiatives across product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to craft technical positioning and messaging that drives adoption and shapes market perception.
  • Analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience measuring success and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Highly self-motivated and collaborative, thriving in a fast-paced, global, remote-first environment.
  • Hands-on experience creating and editing technical content (e.g., architecture diagrams, documentation, SDK/CLI guides, technical blog posts) is a strong plus.

What do we offer?

  • Contractor (PJ)
  • Paid Time Off
  • Competitive Compensation
  • Wellhub (former Gympass)
  • Annual Bonus based on company and team performance

title: Graphic Designer + Marketing Assistant + Video Editor
description:
Graphic Designer & Marketing Assistant (Home Renovation / Roofing)

Company: 2URN Marketing — performance marketing for roofing & home renovation contractors

Website:

Location: Remote (USA) — Standard hours 9:00–5:00 PM CDT

Type: Full-time (open to contractor-to-hire)

Why this role exists

We create ads that make the phone ring for roofers. You’ll turn raw ideas and footage into scroll-stopping creative, edit content fast, and support campaign execution. If you can edit content at a high level, you’re a #1-priority candidate—design skills matter, but content editing chops win.

What you’ll do (outcomes, not busywork)

  • Produce ad creative: Design static graphics and short-form video for Meta / TikTok / YouTube / Display; iterate quickly based on performance data.
  • Edit content end-to-end: Cut UGC, before / after, job-site clips; add captions, hooks, overlays, CTAs; ship multiple variations.
  • Build offer / angle packs: Translate roofing value props (financing, storm damage, warranties, same-day inspection) into hooks, headlines, and visuals.
  • Launch + maintain assets: Prep export specs, thumbnails, landing page hero graphics, and ad library organization.
  • Brand standards: Create and maintain lightweight brand kits per client (logos, palettes, typography, truck / crew photos).
  • Creative testing: Set up A / B creative matrices; document learnings; kill losers, scale winners.
  • Light marketing ops: Assist with ad uploads, naming conventions, UTM hygiene, and creative calendars.
  • Industry learning: Rapidly absorb what makes roofing ads work: seasonality, storm events, insurance language, compliance “do’s and don’ts.”

Must-have skills & experience

  • 2–5+ years in graphic design and / or content editing (agency, in-house, or freelance). Roofing / home services / renovation background strongly preferred.
  • Editor-first: Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or Final Cut + After Effects basics. Figma / Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop proficiency.
  • Proven portfolio of direct-response creative (ads that sell, not just look pretty).
  • Strong sense of hooks, pacing, and clarity; understands attention economics for 3–30s ads.
  • Comfortable working from raw, imperfect footage (phone clips, job-site audio) and making it look sharp.
  • Solid copy instincts: headlines, overlays, lower-thirds, CTA placement.
  • Organized: version control, file naming, and asset libraries.

Nice-to-haves

  • Roofing / home services portfolio (before / after, crew, drone, hail / storm angles).
  • UGC direction: writing briefs, coaching talent, shot lists.
  • Basic landing page design (Figma / Webflow / Canva) and thumbnail optimization.

What success looks like (90-day scorecard)

  • Ship 30–50 creative variations / month across clients (mix of video + static).
  • Hit ≥ 3 winning creatives / month (defined as 20–40%+ lift in CTR / CVR vs. control).
  • Build / maintain client brand kits and a searchable asset library.
  • Document a Creative Playbook for roofing offers, angles, and compliance.

KPIs you’ll own

  • Thumb-stop / 3-sec view rate (shorts / reels).
  • CTR on first-touch ads; CPL contribution for lead gen funnels.
  • Creative velocity: variants shipped per week and on-time rate.
  • Iteration speed: time from data insight → new variant live.

Tools we use

Adobe CC (Premiere / AE / PS / AI) or CapCut Pro, Figma, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Meta Ads Library, Frame.io (or equivalent).

Work setup

Fully remote. Standard working hours 9:00–5:00 PM Central (CDT). Occasional optional travel for content capture or team onsites.

Compensation

  • $500–$1,000 per month (DOE) + performance bonus tied to creative wins.
  • Benefits (if full-time): PTO, holidays, gear stipend, education budget.
  • Growth path: Senior Creative → Creative Lead (own testing roadmap and junior designers).

How to apply

Apply via our website: (Careers / Contact). Include:

  • Portfolio link + 2–3 ad examples with a one-liner on why they worked
  • Your tool stack + availability
  • Confirmation you can work 9:00–5:00 PM CDT (align your timezone)

Paid test (required)

We’ll give you a raw roofing job-site folder (clips + stills). In 48 hours, deliver:

  • 2 x 15s vertical ads (3 hook variants each)
  • 2 static ads (before / after + financing angle)
  • Project file + export settings + a one-page rationale

Role expectations (how we work)

  • Iterate fast. Done > perfect; perfect comes from rounds of data-driven edits.
  • Own the result. If CPL is high, you propose creative fixes—don’t wait for orders.
  • Be practical. Clarity beats clever. Results beat awards.

Equal Opportunity

We hire for skill, speed, and integrity. All backgrounds welcome.

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don\'t need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You\'ll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder\'s priorities aligned. Operations & Integrator Coordination : 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.

Marketing & Content Coordination : 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.

  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support : 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder\'s calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder\'s ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.

  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.

What You Should Have

  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications :

  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM

Nice-to-haves :

Who You Are

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. The core values that guide us are : act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity / IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity / IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.
  • You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn :

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration : Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP / IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

title: Compliance Specialist
description:
Overview

Compliance Specialist

We are seeking a remote, full-time SOC 2 Compliance Specialist with expertise in SaaS environments and proficiency in using compliance management platforms (preferably Vanta). The ideal candidate will lead the client's SOC 2 compliance efforts, streamline evidence collection, ensure continuous monitoring, and support security and compliance programs to meet industry standards and customer expectations.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management: Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization: Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring: Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)
  • Policy Development: Develop, update, and maintain security and compliance policies, procedures, and documentation within Vanta's centralized platform
  • Vendor Risk Management: Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support: Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness: Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics: Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated: Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement

Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Overview

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

title: Advogado(a) Júnior - Consultivo
description:
Overview

Você terá a missão de apoiar a equipe jurídica na prestação de serviços estratégicos com foco em Direito Contratual, Trabalhista, Societário e Tecnologia. Atuará na elaboração de documentos, pareceres, revisão de contratos e no suporte a projetos e em negociações contribuindo diretamente para a excelência no atendimento aos clientes e para o sucesso dos projetos da área.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Revisar, redigir e negociar contratos e outros documentos jurídicos em diversas áreas do Direito com ênfase no segmento de negócios que envolvam Tecnologia, assegurando conformidade legal e minimização de riscos, sob a supervisão de advogados mais experientes.
  • Preparar minutas de notificações extrajudiciais e documentos relacionados.
  • Fornecer pareceres, videoconferências, reuniões presenciais e outros meios de interação sempre com o acompanhamento e orientação de advogados mais experientes, quando necessário.
  • Participar de demandas que envolvem alterações de contratos sociais e/ou estatutos sociais, atas de reuniões e/ou assembleias de sócios e atas de assembleias de acionistas.
  • Auxiliar na análise e revisão de políticas de privacidade, termos de uso, e contratos de processamento de dados para garantir conformidade com a LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados).
  • Participar na avaliação de práticas de segurança da informação dos clientes e sugerir melhorias para minimizar riscos de vazamentos de dados e outras violações de segurança.
  • Auxiliar na consultoria preventiva para clientes, orientando sobre boas práticas na gestão de dados pessoais.

Tipo de contratação e modelo de trabalho

  • Forma de contratação: Início como Advogado(a) Associado(a). Após 3 meses, inclusão no Contrato Social como Sócio(a) de Serviço.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Home office, de segunda a sexta-feira, das 09h às 18h. Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente em encontros da equipe ou quando houver reuniões com cliente.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior concluída em Direito;
  • OAB ativa;
  • Experiência prévia na elaboração, revisão e negociação de contratos.
  • Vivência em Direito Societário, Trabalhista e Contratual, especialmente em negócios que envolvem tecnologia (desejável).
  • Noções sobre políticas de privacidade, termos de uso e processamento de dados.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado (diferencial, mas não obrigatório).
  • Curso de especialização voltadas para áreas consultivas (será um diferencial).

Benefícios

  • Anuidade da OAB custeada pelo escritório.
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica AMIL (após 3 meses de contrato).
  • Remuneração adicional ao ano (colaboradores com mínimo de 6 meses de escritório recebem o valor proporcional; se estiver no escritório em dezembro do ano corrente, receberá o benefício).
  • Day Off no aniversário.
  • 30 dias de férias remuneradas (após 1 ano de contrato).

Outros requisitos

  • Visão estratégica e foco em resultados.
  • Proatividade e disposição para aprender continuamente.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe e colaboração.
  • Adaptabilidade para atuar em demandas diversas.

Sobre o escritório

O Assis e Mendes é um escritório especializado em Direito Digital, Empresarial e Proteção de Dados. Construímos nosso sólido posicionamento no mercado, desde 2006, através da prestação de serviços jurídicos a diversas Empresas de Tecnologia. Fomos um dos escritórios pioneiros no estudo e implementação da GDPR e LGPD no Brasil.

Valorizamos a diversidade, inclusão e equidade. Acreditamos que ao acolher e respeitar a singularidade de cada membro da nossa equipe, enriquecemos nosso ambiente de trabalho e fortalecemos nossas capacidades coletivas. Nosso objetivo é simplificar as relações empresariais com segurança jurídica, para agregar valor e eficácia aos negócios. Procuramos compreender o negócio dos nossos clientes e apoiá-los para alcançar seus objetivos, de forma lícita, eficaz e objetiva.

Estamos procurando um Analista Funcional para atuar em projetos de mapeamento de processos e apoio à transformação digital, com foco em soluções voltadas para canais de atendimento. Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada como Analista Funcional em projetos de mapeamento de processos e transformação digital;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de processos (ex: BPMN) e ferramentas como Visio, Bizagi, Lucidchart ou similares;
  • Vivência com sistemas de atendimento multicanal (telefone, chat, e-mail, CRM);
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação, organização e relacionamento com áreas diversas.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com projetos envolvendo Salesforce;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Certificações em análise de negócios (CBAP, PMI-PBA) são um diferencial.
  • Vale alimentação ou refeição (Swile): R$ 660,00/mês;
  • Auxílio Home Office: R$ 100,00/mês;
  • Auxílio Creche (conforme acordo coletivo);
  • Plano de Saúde SulAmérica Clássico (100% custeado pela empresa, sem coparticipação);
  • Plano Odontológico SulAmérica (100% custeado pela empresa, sem coparticipação);
  • Auxílio Educação Alura (mensalidade paga 100% pela empresa);
  • Parceria com escolas de inglês e faculdades;
  • Total Pass: academias e aplicativos educacionais com descontos;
  • Wellhub: academias e aplicativos educacionais com descontos;
  • Acesso ao Sesc São Paulo.

Sobre a empresa

Somos a BetterNow, uma consultoria em qualidade de software que valoriza relações próximas, processos simples e um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo. Nosso propósito é criar soluções que realmente façam a diferença, com foco na excelência, na transparência e na entrega de valor para os nossos clientes. Aqui, você vai encontrar uma cultura aberta, que valoriza a troca de ideias, o aprendizado contínuo e a autonomia. Trabalhamos com metodologias ágeis, buscamos inovação e acreditamos que, mais do que processos, são as pessoas que garantem a qualidade em cada entrega. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, com desafios reais e oportunidade de crescer junto, a BetterNow é o seu lugar!

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Mútua

Mútua is an AI-powered platform that bridges mission-driven funders—from philanthropic to commercial—with innovators across sectors, from startups to NGOs. By aligning capital with high-impact solutions in essential systems like food & land use, energy, education, and healthcare, Mútua increases decision-making accuracy for funders and empowers innovators to access critical resources. Our technology unlocks untapped potential by transforming fragmented impact data into actionable intelligence, driving transformational impact across geographies and systems.

The Role

We are looking for a proactive, hands-on, and purpose-driven AI Engineer to strengthen our product and consulting solutions. You’ll be at the forefront of applying Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, and AI agents to solve real-world challenges in impact investing. In this role, you’ll begin with a strategic project to develop Mútua’s conversational interface, a cornerstone of our product experience. This will serve as your entry point into a broader journey of scaling our AI methodologies across the platform. You’ll work closely with our CTO and benefit from the premium technical support and Skills Boost access provided by Google through our grant.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, test, and deploy prompt engineering and prompt chaining workflows in collaboration with the business and product teams.
  • Implement and refine RAG pipelines to combine structured and unstructured data for better discovery and recommendations.
  • Define and execute model evaluation strategies to benchmark LLMs and ensure reliability.
  • Develop human-in-the-loop systems that balance automation with expert oversight.
  • Explore and deploy AI agents to support discovery, classification, and recommendation workflows.
  • Collaborate with both the core product team and the Systems Intelligence Services team on high-value consulting projects that integrate back into our platform.

We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience working directly with LLMs (development, deployment, or applied research).
  • Strong knowledge of prompt engineering and hands-on experience with conversational AI.
  • Experience with RAG, model evaluation, and human-in-the-loop pipelines.
  • Use workflow automation / orchestration tools (e.g. n8n, LangChain, or similar) to structure and scale prompt chaining and LLM pipelines.
  • Bonus: experience with Google Vertex AI or AI Studio.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset, able to move from concept to working prototype in short cycles.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, comfortable in a flexible, fully remote, task-based environment.
  • Fluent in English
  • Passion for building technologies that drive systemic social and environmental impact.

Why Mútua?

  • Competitive early-stage compensation with clear pathway to equity (stock options).
  • Fully remote, flexible, and outcome-oriented work environment.
  • Opportunity to consolidate your career as an AI Engineer working on the frontier of LLM applications.
  • Direct access to Google experts and resources, thanks to our $250k grant.
  • A collaborative, mission-driven culture that values growth, learning, and innovation.

Join us at Mútua

Be part of a team pioneering essential infrastructure for the global impact ecosystem, while building your career at the cutting edge of applied AI.

Overview

AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)

About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS / CRM, etc.).

Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.

The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50% : OCR → parse → validate → post touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance : Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑ : Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments / write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑ : Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑ : AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed : Live Sheets / Excel / Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor : MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.

What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines : OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation : Primary-source license checks, date / format rules, name / DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG / OT).
  • Workflow integrations : Event-driven APIs / webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM / Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation : AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS / CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies / MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record : Integrate VoIP / SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS / Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation : Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage / routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation : Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing / job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation : Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required) : Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to :
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits / adjustments.
  • Sync AR / AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants : RAG chatbots over Confluence / SharePoint / Drive / ATS / CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting : Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.

MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset / prompt / embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline / online evals; A / B tests.
  • CI / CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency / reliability SLOs; canary / blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries / backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces / metrics / cost), drift detection, PII / HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance : token / throughput controls, caching / TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.

Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and / or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM / RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF / HTML / images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design ( HIPAA / PII ), APIs / webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS / Compliance / Job Boards / HubSpot / Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing / payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals : data / model versioning, CI / CD, monitoring, rollback.

Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing / credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS / workflow tools (Zapier / Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS / App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI / LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.

Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership : Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover : Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack : Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM / Marketing (HubSpot / Salesforce) , VoIP / SMS, CMS, accounting / payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes : Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture : Production over prototypes, HIPAA / PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.

title: Netsuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location : Remote – Brazil

Salary : USD 1,700 / month

Schedule : 40 hours / week

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

Key Responsibilities

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

description:
Overview

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers\' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

Additional Information

The Team

The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Demand Generation Manager, Sales Enablement Focus
description:
Overview

Douglas Adams once said, "Technology is a word that describes something that doesn\'t work yet." Funny, because it\'s true — so much so that it sparked our unrelenting mission to increase the positive impact of technology on people\'s lives.

From robot vacuums and voice assistants to banking apps, smart toys, and backyard grills, Centercode has helped shape countless products in virtually every household — and chances are good we\'ve impacted your life already. We\'re full of people who take pride in striving toward our goals and having a blast while doing it. We\'re always on the lookout for enthusiastic, like-minded people to join us in making everyday life better through technology.

As a Demand Generation Manager , you\'ll be the engine that fuels Centercode\'s growth— generating awareness that turns curiosity into conversations, conversations into opportunities, and opportunities into evangelists. You\'ll own and optimize the earliest stage of our revenue funnel, building programs that spark interest, and convert inbound leads into qualified meetings. You\'ll also manage our communities and mobilize Centercode Advocates.   • Program Execution: Coordinate lead engagement around Centercode\'s online communities and events, including trade shows, summits, webinars, and LinkedIn Live, ensuring optimized Hubspot sequences and proper lead routing, and managing onboarding for sales enablement

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with Sales and Marketing to define enablement needs across prospecting, qualification, and closing stages

What You Need to Do the Job

  • 4+ years experience in B2B demand generation, with at least 2 years in sales enablement or a closely aligned role
  • Strong understanding of the SaaS sales cycle and qualification frameworks
  • Experience converting leads to opportunities in the SaaS space
  • Excellent writing, research, and communication skills for lead conversion
  • A self-starting mindset for building new processes from scratch
  • CRM Proficiency (HubSpot preferred) and experience with AI tools

What\'ll Give You an Edge

  • Prior experience in beta testing, insights, or crowdsource technology space

  • Experience partnering directly with sales teams to design campaigns that accelerate pipeline velocity
  • Success with engaging communities with content and events

  • Sorry, Recruiters: We\'re not open to working with you on this role

More About Us

Centercode is a highly innovative tech company and we\'re growing all the time. Our weird and wonderful work culture is unified by geeking out hard over tech — the old, the new, and the yet-to-exist. We value adaptability over perfectionism and productivity over long hours. Also, towels. They\'re very important to us.

You\'ll Fit Right In If

  • You love emerging tech — using it, talking about it, tinkering with it
  • You\'re obsessed with using AI to amplify your productivity
  • You\'re not afraid to ask (or answer) stupid questions
  • You\'re a strong communicator but your an even better listener
  • You were triggered by the grammar in that last bullet
  • Your coworkers speak highly of you and your work
  • You know your biggest weakness — and it isn\'t that you\'re a perfectionist
  • You\'re a Builder with a track record to prove it
  • You\'re willing to admit when you screw up (it happens to the best of us)

Plus a Few Pleasant Surprises

title: Senior Underwriter
description:
Overview

Position Summary: The Senior Mortgage Underwriter is responsible for evaluating residential loan applications to ensure sound credit decisions in accordance with investor guidelines, regulatory requirements, and company policies. This role serves as a subject matter expert in complex loan scenarios, provides mentorship to junior underwriters, and supports cross-functional collaboration to drive operational excellence, risk mitigation, and superior service delivery.

Qualifications

  • College degree in business, finance, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of mortgage underwriting experience.
  • FHA Direct Endorsement (DE) certification with at least two (2) years of FHA underwriting experience required.
  • VA Credit/SAR authority with a minimum of two (2) years of VA underwriting experience required or in progress.
  • Experience underwriting a variety of loan products, including Bond, Jumbo, USDA, and other specialty programs (minimum of two years).
  • Strong knowledge of agency, investor, and regulatory underwriting standards (FNMA, FHLMC, FHA, VA, USDA).
  • Certification as a Mortgage Underwriter preferred.
  • Excellent analytical, credit evaluation, and decision-making skills with a focus on detail and accuracy.
  • Proficient in loan origination systems (e.g., Encompass) and automated underwriting tools.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and in a collaborative environment.
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced setting.

Essential Job Functions

  • Underwrite residential mortgage loan files within delegated authority, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Analyze borrower income, credit, assets, liabilities, and collateral to determine risk and loan eligibility.
  • Assess appraisal reports and property valuations to confirm loan-to-value (LTV) and property eligibility.
  • Issue clear and well-supported decisions, including approvals, counteroffers, suspensions, and denials.
  • Maintain compliance with all applicable federal and state laws, agency/investor guidelines, and internal policies.
  • Meet or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for underwriting turn times.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior underwriters and support staff.
  • Collaborate with loan officers, processors, and closers to resolve conditions and expedite loan decisions.
  • Identify potential fraud indicators, misrepresentation, or red flags, and escalate appropriately.
  • Support quality control and audit readiness by ensuring documentation and data integrity.
  • Stay informed of changes in underwriting guidelines, industry best practices, and regulatory developments.
  • Accurately document underwriting decisions and maintain system records with complete audit trails.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service to internal teams and external partners to enhance the loan experience.
  • Participate in special projects or initiatives as assigned.

Working Conditions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit and talk or hear. Specific vision abilities this job requires include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

title: Analista De Sustentação Mainframe
description:
A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança. Elaborar análises específicas e relatórios recorrentes, atendendo demandas de diferentes áreas da empresa, garantindo consistência e clareza nas entregas. Atuar no processo de ETL (Extração, Transformação e Carga), organizando e tratando dados a partir de bases SQL para embasar análises e painéis. Desenvolver dashboards interativos em Power BI, utilizando boas práticas de visualização de dados e DAX, permitindo a identificação de tendências e suporte à tomada de decisão. Colaborar com áreas parceiras e stakeholders diversos, entendendo suas necessidades e traduzindo-as em análises estratégicas, com boa comunicação e flexibilidade diante de ambientes pouco estruturados. Construir cenários e diagnósticos de performance, como investigação de gargalos operacionais, contribuindo para ações corretivas e melhorias contínuas. Requisitos: Ensino superior completo em Administração Financeira, Economia, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou área correlatas. Experiência avançada em Power BI. Conhecimento intermediário a avançado em SQL: Capacidade de consultar e manipular dados. Proficiência em DAX: É imprescindível ter um entendimento de DAX para construir análises complexas. Habilidades em Data Visualization para apresentar os dados de forma que faça sentido para os diversos stakeholders. Diferencial : Conhecimento em bases de atendimento, como Zendesk. description: Korn Ferry, on behalf of John Deere, a U.S. multinational company and leader in the agricultural and construction machinery industry, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer for a position based in Indaiatuba, SP. Key Responsibilities Front-End Development – Build scalable, high-performance front-end applications using React. UI/UX Collaboration – Work closely with designers and product teams to deliver intuitive, customer-centric interfaces. Backend Integration – Contribute to backend development when needed, ensuring seamless front-end/back-end integration. API Development & Integration – Connect front-end solutions with APIs and ensure smooth data flow across platforms. Cloud & DevOps Enablement – Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and deployment. Technology Exploration – Evaluate and adopt emerging tools, including GenAI, to drive innovation and improve productivity. Quality & Security by Design – Apply best practices in coding, testing, and security to ensure robust and reliable solutions. Main Challenges and Assignments Deliver modern, React-based user interfaces that integrate seamlessly with backend systems. Ensure front-end solutions are scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance. Adapt quickly to new technologies and contribute across the stack when necessary. Support the adoption of AI and GenAI to enhance customer-facing applications. Maintain alignment with John Deere’s vision for autonomous operations, AI, and digital optimization. Experience & Qualifications Must-have: Extensive hands-on experience with React and front-end frameworks. Solid understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3. Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with backend services. Familiarity with cloud platforms, containers, and CI/CD pipelines. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with a focus on user experience. Collaborative mindset, willing to contribute to both front-end and backend tasks. Differential: Experience with GenAI projects (e.G., LLM-based applications, AI-powered features). Differential: Exposure to multi-cloud environments or full-stack design patterns. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. Advanced/Fluent English to collaborate in an international environment. description: O Desafio Procuramos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Inteligência Artificial Sênior apaixonado(a) por transformar dados em soluções escaláveis, com conhecimento consolidado em LLMs e IA. Projetar e construir arquiteturas de software escaláveis para hospedar e gerenciar LLMs e outros modelos de IA. Implementar e otimizar pipelines de MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) para garantir a entrega contínua, deployment e monitoramento de modelos. Desenvolver e otimizar estratégias de Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para LLMs, visando a extração precisa de informações clínicas e a geração de respostas contextuais. Escrever códigos de forma limpa, escalável, performática e testável, aplicando os melhores padrões de engenharia de software. Analisar requerimentos de negócio e produto, transformando-os em especificações técnicas e priorizando tarefas de alto impacto. Colaborar ativamente com cientistas de dados, engenheiros de dados e especialistas de domínio (médicos) para garantir a relevância e eficácia das soluções de IA. Manter-se atualizado(a) com as últimas pesquisas e avanços em IA, PLN e LLMs, e avaliar a aplicação de novas tecnologias. Requisitos Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Software ou IA Sênior, com foco em sistemas de IA/ML em produção. Proficiência avançada em Python e experiência com frameworks de ML/DL (e.G., PyTorch, TensorFlow). Conhecimento consolidado e experiência prática com Large Language Models (LLMs), incluindo técnicas (e.G., Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning, RAG) e ferramentas (e.G., Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex). Experiência robusta no desenvolvimento e implantação de pipelines de MLOps e em plataformas de nuvem (e.G., AWS SageMaker, Azure ML). Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos (Docker, Kubernetes). Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL. Capacidade de escrever e implementar rotinas de testes abrangentes para código e modelos de IA. Habilidade de liderança técnica para projetos, decisões arquiteturais e mentoria de equipes. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe. Conhecimentos Desejáveis Fluência em inglês. Experiência com C# e .NET (para integração). Conhecimento de frameworks front-end (Angular, React) para interfaces de IA. Experiência específica com dados de saúde (HL7, FHIR) ou no setor de healthtech. Otimização de modelos para inferência em larga escala (e.G., com GPUs). Conhecimento em ética em IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e viés em modelos. Se você quer atuar no cruzamento entre tecnologia de ponta, IA, dados complexos e saúde - e gosta de resolver problemas que fazem a diferença na vida de milhares, impulsionando a próxima geração da medicina - se candidate e venha conversar conosco!

description: É apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, orientado(a) a resultados e gosta de desafios?	 Então venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e nos ajude em nossa missão: transformar a internet em um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas! Com forte comprometimento, inovação e de forma dinâmica você será responsável por:  Auxiliar na configuração, manutenção e monitoramento de redes de computadores.  Prestar suporte técnico aos serviços oferecidos pela UPX ao cliente final.  Monitorar incidentes de redes, e ataques DDo S. Executar e documentar processos, procedimentos e incidentes relacionados à rede e à segurança de TI.  Participar de treinamentos e atualizações sobre novas tecnologias e práticas de segurança. Conhecimento em protocolos de rede (IPv4, IPv6, TCP/UDP e DNS).  Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e segurança de redes.  Experiência prévia na instalação e configuração de equipamentos de rede, como roteadores, switches, firewalls e sistemas de detecção e prevenção de intrusão (IDS/IPS).  Habilidade para resolver problemas técnicos de forma ágil e eficiente.  Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.  Diferencial: Certificações como CCNA, JNCIA-Junos, JNCIA-DC, MTCNA ou equivalentes.  Experiência com protocolo BGP é altamente desejável. Sobre a UPX: A UPX está há duas décadas no mercado, é referência em mitigação de ataques DDo S, e destaque no monitoramento, identificação, tratamento, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo (CDN e Streaming) com elevado desempenho. Está presente em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), tem em seu portfólio grandes clientes do setor bancário e financeiro, operadoras de telecom e provedores de internet (ISP). 	 Atua combatendo ataques, vulnerabilidades e ameaças cibernéticas com apoio de um time técnico de Segurança da Informação e Engenharia de Redes que operam por meio de SOC (Security Operations Center), NOC (Network Operations Center) e Scrubbing Centers (Centros de Mitigação). title: Tradutor
description: Sobre a NARI Brasil  A NARI Brasil é uma empresa integrante ao NARI Group Corporation, líder no fornecimento de equipamentos para o setor de energia elétrica na China. Fundado em 1973, o grupo NARI dedica-se a oferecer tecnologias de ponta.  Desde sua fundação no Brasil em 2013 com suas operações em Sorocaba-SP, a NARI Brasil tem se destacado no desenvolvimento e comercialização de sistemas de controle e proteção de subestações, com foco em soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade.  Oportunidade  Tradutor(a) | Mandarim - Português  Buscamos um profissional para atuar como elo de comunicação entre equipes chinesas e brasileiras, facilitando a integração linguística e cultural nas atividades operacionais, administrativas e estratégicas da empresa. A posição requer alto nível de fluência em chinês mandarim e português brasileiro, além de sensibilidade intercultural para lidar com ambientes corporativos bilíngues e multiculturais.  Se você possui experiência na área e está em busca de desafios, essa oportunidade pode ser interessante para você!  Requisitos • Superior preferencialmente em Letras, Tradução, Relações Internacionais ou áreas afins; • Fluência comprovada em Chinês/Mandarim, com excelentes habilidades de compreensão auditiva, conversação, leitura e escrita; • Fluência em português brasileiro, com excelente comunicação verbal e escrita. • Ter fortes habilidades de comunicação intercultural, trabalhar de forma meticulosa e consciente e ser capaz de se adaptar a um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico.  Diferenciais: • Domínio de espanhol e/ou inglês; • Familiaridade com a cultura e o ambiente de negócios brasileiros.   Descrição das Atividades • Servir como ponto de contato bilíngue entre a matriz Chinesa e o escritório local, fornecedores e parceiros comerciais, garantindo a fluidez na comunicação e o alinhamento cultural. • Realizar traduções precisas (oral e escrita) entre chinês mandarim e português, em reuniões, documentos, e comunicações internas e externas; • Atuar como facilitador no andamento de projetos corporativos • Auxiliar na mediação entre as equipes chinesas e brasileiras, promovendo entendimento mútuo e facilitando a colaboração; • Participar de negociações, treinamentos, visitas técnicas e eventos institucionais, assegurando que todas as partes compreendam as informações com clareza.

title: Lead accountant (brazil) - sqm iodine & plant nutrition
description: SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition   , a global mining and chemical company, has a worldwide leadership position in the markets in which we are present, which is possible thanks to the strategic location of our operations in northern Chile, from where we have access to high-value resources, in addition to our network of commercial offices that allows us to reach more than 100 countries with our products. YOUR MISSION  Oversee and coordinate the company's administrative and financial activities, ensuring the efficient use of resources, compliance with accounting, tax, and legal obligations, and the generation of reliable information for decision-making. The objective is to guarantee financial stability, operational efficiency, and adequate support for other areas of the organization.  WHAT YOU’LL DO  Bank Management  Receive, review, and process invoice payments.  Monitor cash balances based on the Company's cash flow needs.  Prepare bank reconciliations.  Third-Party Management  Keep customer and supplier master data up to date.  Request third-party assessments through the Compliance platform.  Credit and Commercial Control  Review and release customer orders in accordance with commercial risk policies.  Request credit line approvals from the insurer and internal managers, depending on the amount of exposure.  Request credit line extensions from the insurer when necessary.  Control and monitor customer credit lines.  Inventory Management  Perform the monthly closing of the inventory module.  Participate in the physical inventory control committees (quarterly).  Record adjustments resulting from physical inventory counts (when applicable).  Fixed Assets and Leases (IFRS 16) Control recorded fixed assets.  Manage and monitor lease agreements in accordance with IFRS 16.  Review monthly depreciation of fixed assets and leases.  Payroll Management  Calculate sales commissions payable to the sales department.  Review payroll processed by the accounting outsourcing company.  Review monthly balances to be accounted for related to health, parafiscal contributions, and social benefits.  General Accounting  Provide support for the proper recording of accounting transactions.  Validate exchange rate controls on a quarterly basis.  Coordinate the closing and opening of accounting periods.  Manage accounting structures and taxes.  Send the monthly closing schedule to the relevant areas.  Other Routine Activities  Respond to and follow up on requests from the Statutory Auditor and external advisors.  Respond to requests from Corporate Audit.  Monitor and follow up on internal control.  Provide administrative support in response to requests from other areas, the Finance Manager, or other corporate management.  Analyze and communicate transfer pricing adjustments, when applicable.  Request supplier approvals in accordance with compliance criteria.  Manage expense reports on the Rydoo platform.  Prepare employment certificates.  Fill out forms for supplier registration.  Follow up on requirements from control entities.  Attend to legal procedures that apply to the company.  THE SKILLS YOU’LL NEED  Graduate in Accounting (Accounting Sciences) – qualification recognized in Brazil (active CRC) Desirable Postgraduate degree in Finance, Taxation, or International Standards (IFRS) Minimum 5 years in accounting roles (general accounting, taxes, financial reporting), preferably in medium or large companies.  Languages: Portuguese, English and Spanish.  Brazilian accounting (local standards), taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL), accounting reconciliations, tax compliance, reporting to the Federal Revenue Service.  Advanced proficiency in Excel  Desirable use of Odoo  Solid knowledge of Brazilian tax and accounting legislation: IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS, PIS/COFINS  Brazilian accounting standards (CPCs), IFRS, internal accounting closing and reconciliation procedures  Active registration with the CRC (Regional Accounting Council); IFRS course or tax MBA desirable.  WE OFFER:  Permanent hiring    Working day: Monday to Friday  Place of work: Initially, it will be remote work, followed by office work in Campinas, Brazil  The opportunity to belong and develop in a dynamic work environment and continuous learning  At  SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition  we are committed to the  Inclusion Law (Law N°21.015) , so we invite you to inform us if you require any adjustment to properly participate in our selection processes.

Continuous improvement: Track activation/engagement/retention, run A/B experiments, and prioritize UX/performance/stability improvements.  Competitor research: Benchmark features/flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.  Reporting & rituals:  Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:  What was completed today.  The current task and ETA for completion.  The next 3 tasks with planned start/end dates.  Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).  Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).  Mirror this view in Jira dashboards/filters with Stage/Prod target dates visible.  Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).  Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.  Must-Haves: 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.  Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.  Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code/PRs at a high level.  Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.  Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.  Nice to Have:  Exposure to Web RTC/A/V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.  Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.
